_readme: Demo seed (PRD: Demo script and seed data). Three fictional clients, five projects. Seed emails are sent from teammates' real addresses, so map each teammate address to a client under contacts. Replace every CHANGE_ME address before the demo; `npm run seed` warns while any remain.

projects.name: Lobby redesign
projects.summary: Redesign of the ground-floor lobby; client sends marked-up floor plans and site photos.

projects.name: Route dashboard
projects.summary: Ops dashboard for live routes; client reports bugs with screenshots.

projects.name: Driver app pilot
projects.summary: Pilot of the driver mobile app with a subset of drivers; pilot date is client-driven.

projects.name: Website refresh
projects.summary: Refresh of the clinic marketing site; a quote for added pages is outstanding.

projects.summary: Online booking integration with the clinic's scheduling system.
